title: Secretaria clinica odontológica
description:
Descrição da Empresa: Clinica Odontológica de médio porte localizado na Área Octogonal, Brasília-DF.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de uma Secretaria Clínica Odontológica para atuar em nossa equipe em Brasília, Distrito Federal. Este cargo requer o gerenciamento de tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao funcionamento diário da clínica, como o agendamento de consultas, organização de documentos e atendimento a pacientes. Outras responsabilidades incluem suporte direto à equipe odontológica, garantindo um ambiente organizado e eficiente. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.
Qualificações
Habilidades Administrativas: Experiência em tarefas administrativas e organizacionais, como gestão de documentos e controle de agenda.
Comunicação: Boa habilidade verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e cortês com pacientes e a equipe da clínica.
Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência com atendimento ao público, garantindo uma experiência excepcional e demonstrando empatia e profissionalismo.
Suporte Administrativo: Conhecimento em assistência administrativa e secretarial para dar suporte ao time odontológico nas rotinas da clínica.
Requisitos adicionais, como cursos voltados à área odontológica, serão considerados diferenciais.

title: Bdr (business development representative)
description:
About Foundey
Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting Saa S, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey's pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in Saa S, AI, and tech companies.
You'll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and research potential clients within Saa S, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
Conduct outbound prospecting via email, Linked In, and other channels
Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
Track activities and performance using CRM tools
Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback Qualifications
3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in Saa S or agency environments)
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce)
Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus) Nice to Have
Experience selling design, product, or digital services
Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
Experience working with early-stage startups or founders Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Desenvolvedor backend sênior node
description:

Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Espera-se que este profissional garanta a estabilidade e a performance das aplicações Back-end (Node.js), dissemine boas práticas de engenharia (como Clean Code e SOLID) através de Code Reviews rigorosos e atue como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores de níveis Júnior e Pleno, elevando a barra técnica do time sem perder o foco na entrega de valor para o negócio.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Type Script e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.
Realizar Code Reviews detalhados, garantindo a qualidade do código, segurança e a conformidade com os padrões arquiteturais definidos.

Domínio na construção de APIs RESTful e uso de frameworks como Nest JS ou Express.
Vivência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria (AWS SQS/SNS ou similares).
Experiência com bancos de dados No SQL (Mongo DB), incluindo modelagem e otimização de performance.
Conhecimento sólido em serviços da AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB, S3).
Prática habitual de escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
Habilidade com Git, fluxos de Code Review e ambientes de CI/CD. Diferencial:
Experiência com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes).
Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou Serverless Framework).
Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic ou Cloud Watch).
Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL) ou caches (Redis).
Conhecimento em práticas de segurança de aplicação (OWASP). Modelo de Contratação:
Regime: PJ + Benefícios.
Localização: 100% Remoto

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group's investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.
For more information, please see our video

title: Legal writer
description:
U. S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.

title: Data analyst
description:
Data Analyst
Location: Brazil (Remote)
Duration: Approximately 6 months
Compensation: R$9,802.52 monthly (Full-Time Equivalent)
Position Overview
The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics.
In this role, you will partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, analyze customer behavior, and drive data-informed decisions across the organization.
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can effectively translate data into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Identify business questions, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities, translating them into structured analytical approaches
Deliver insights on business performance, operational efficiency, financial drivers, and key strategic KPIs
Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models to support decision-making
Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses to explain trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and ensure alignment with business objectives
Collaborate with data engineering, finance, and analytics teams to ensure data quality and scalable reporting solutions
Translate complex data into clear, concise insights and present findings to senior leadership
Contribute to improving analytical frameworks, tools, and best practices within the team Minimum Qualifications
Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or a related quantitative field
5+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, or performance management
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python)
Experience with BI tools (preferably Power BI) for dashboarding and reporting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems
Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional environments
Fluency in English Preferred Qualifications
Experience in financial analytics or business performance management
Familiarity with advanced analytics (forecasting, statistical analysis, scenario modeling)
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS)
Knowledge of data pipelines, automation, or orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Py Spark)
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

title: Bdr (business development representative)
description:
About Foundey
Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting Saa S, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey's pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in Saa S, AI, and tech companies.
You'll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and research potential clients within Saa S, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
Conduct outbound prospecting via email, Linked In, and other channels
Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
Track activities and performance using CRM tools
Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback Qualifications
3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in Saa S or agency environments)
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce)
Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus) Nice to Have
Experience selling design, product, or digital services
Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
Experience working with early-stage startups or founders Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Professor de espanhol
description:
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Professor de Espanhol qualificado para ministrar aulas de espanhol de forma remota. As responsabilidades incluem planejar e conduzir aulas de idiomas, adaptar o conteúdo para atender às necessidades individuais dos alunos e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de suas habilidades linguísticas e culturais. Temos foco na variante peninsular, devido ao crescimento da demanda de interessados em viver na Espanha. Este é um cargo de prestação de serviço (MEI) para trabalho remoto.
Qualificações
Ensino de Espanhol: É fundamental ter experiência no ensino do idioma espanhol para variados níveis de proficiência.
Planejamento de Aulas: Capacidade de planejar aulas eficazes e desenvolver estratégias de ensino criativas e envolventes.
Desenvolvimento Curricular e Tutoria: Experiência em criar conteúdos curriculares e oferecer suporte individualizado aos alunos para atender às suas necessidades específicas.
Adicionalmente, um diferencial seria possuir certificações em ensino de idiomas, experiência com ferramentas de ensino online e fluência em português e espanhol e experiência com espanhol europeu.

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Salesforce developer
description:
Company Description
We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote position for a Salesforce Developer. The Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours from 8am to 5pm.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Lightning and Apex
Collaborate with functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions
Perform debugging, testing, and deployment activities
Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing applications Qualifications
In-depth understanding of Salesforce.com platform capabilities and customization
2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development

Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)

Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Observance of major US Federal Holidays

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group's investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.
For more information, please see our video

Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;

Dynamic work in a young team of like-minded people;
Management's attention, support and motivation. The Vehicle Inspector role provides vehicle inspections for customers. Vehicle Inspectors will work in an online environment to provide vehicle inspections via video chat. Having live interaction with
ride share drivers, those with good customer service skills, ability to multitask and can
learn quickly will excel in the Vehicle Inspector role.
AREAS OF FOCUS
● Customer Service
● Vehicle Inspections
● Internal communication
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Initiate video calls with drivers at their scheduled appointment time.
- Camera must remain on during all inspections with the company background
applied. Maintain a professional appearance; casual but neat attire is required.
- Explain the inspection process clearly and concisely.
- Answer basic questions related to the inspection or redirect to the appropriate team
when necessary.

- Guide the driver step-by-step in positioning their phone or camera to show the
necessary parts of the vehicle.
- Exterior and interior of the vehicle (including tires, lights, mirrors, seat belts, horn,
and other key points)
- Observe and assess the condition of each required inspection point to determine
whether the vehicle meets compliance standards.
- Communicate the pass/fail result to the driver and provide a brief explanation if the
vehicle fails.
- Record the inspection outcome (Pass, Fail, or No-Show) in the internal system
immediately after the appointment.
You are our perfect candidate if you are:
●A good communicator, excelent English speaking and writing;

● Rideshare inspection knowledge a plus
● Able to multitask with attention to detail

● Able to work alongside team members in an online environment
● Inspectors must have their own computer, smartphone and strong wifi service
●Are client-oriented and attentive to details, have active listening skills, problem solver, hard-
working, team-player.
●Self-employment. We will sign a contract with you as with independent businessman;
●You can work from home, don't be distracted;

We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.
We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Legal writer
description:
U. S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.
Responsibilities:
Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:
Preparing legal briefs, including personal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments.
Engaging in extensive drafting, developing persuasive and well-structured arguments tailored to each case. Case Strategy & Implementation:
Collaborating with senior legal specialists and U. S. attorneys to understand and execute case strategy effectively.
Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards. Legal Research & Analysis:
Conducting in-depth legal research to identify relevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
Staying up to date with evolving immigration laws and policy changes to ensure compliance and accuracy.
Be creative in drafting – must have!!! Document Review

Ensuring petitions are fully prepared in advance for mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission. Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:

· Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.
· B. A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.
· Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.
· Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.
· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.
· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.
· Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.

title: Data analyst
description:
Data Analyst
Location: Brazil (Remote)
Duration: Approximately 6 months
Compensation: R$9,802.52 monthly (Full-Time Equivalent)
Position Overview
The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics.
In this role, you will partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate business performance, analyze customer behavior, and drive data-informed decisions across the organization.
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can effectively translate data into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Identify business questions, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities, translating them into structured analytical approaches
Deliver insights on business performance, operational efficiency, financial drivers, and key strategic KPIs
Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models to support decision-making
Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses to explain trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and ensure alignment with business objectives
Collaborate with data engineering, finance, and analytics teams to ensure data quality and scalable reporting solutions
Translate complex data into clear, concise insights and present findings to senior leadership
Contribute to improving analytical frameworks, tools, and best practices within the team Minimum Qualifications
Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or a related quantitative field
5+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, or performance management
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python)
Experience with BI tools (preferably Power BI) for dashboarding and reporting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems
Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional environments
Fluency in English Preferred Qualifications
Experience in financial analytics or business performance management
Familiarity with advanced analytics (forecasting, statistical analysis, scenario modeling)
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS)
Knowledge of data pipelines, automation, or orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Py Spark)
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

title: Senior closer
description:
The Differs Company
A The Differs Company ajuda criadores, marcas e empreendedores a se destacarem no digital através de posicionamento estratégico, branding e conteúdos de alto impacto.
Nosso ecossistema inclui mentorias, cursos, consultorias e suporte para crescimento real de negócios, sempre orientado a resultados concretos. Trabalhamos diretamente com o perfil no Instagram, cuja audiência engajada soma centenas de milhares de seguidores, oferecendo oportunidades de venda tanto B2 C quanto B2 B.
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) closer para trabalhar 100% remotamente, com experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas, que saiba conduzir leads do primeiro contato até o fechamento, sem desistir no meio do caminho.
Você será responsável por:
Conduzir calls estratégicas com leads qualificados
Diagnosticar o cenário do cliente e propor soluções de alto valor
Fechar vendas de mentorias, produtos digitais e consultorias B2 B
Lidar com objeções de forma madura e estratégica
Manter registro completo das interações em CRM Oportunidade de crescimento: quem performar acima da média poderá atuar em vendas B2 B de tickets mais altos e consultorias estratégicas.
Qualificações
Experiência comprovada como closer e em vendas consultivas
Capacidade de sustentar a negociação até o fechamento
Perfil persistente, estratégico e orientado a resultados
Habilidade de lidar com objeções complexas
Diferencial: experiência em vendas de mentorias ou produtos de alto valor
Comunicação clara e assertiva, com repertório para conversar com clientes exigentes
Excelente em gramática da Língua Portuguesa Como se candidatar
Envie via inbox:

Uma gravação real de call de vendas para análise Se você sabe fechar vendas de forma consistente e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance, essa é sua oportunidade.

title: Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide
Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.
What you will do
Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed What you will bring to the role
Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities Your experience
Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
Bachelor's degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Bdr (business development representative)
description:
About Foundey
Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting Saa S, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey's pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in Saa S, AI, and tech companies.
You'll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and research potential clients within Saa S, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
Conduct outbound prospecting via email, Linked In, and other channels
Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
Track activities and performance using CRM tools
Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback Qualifications
3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in Saa S or agency environments)
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce)
Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus) Nice to Have
Experience selling design, product, or digital services
Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
Experience working with early-stage startups or founders Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Boa comunicação escrita e capacidade de gerar conexão rapidamente

title: Forensic manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group's investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.
For more information, please see our video

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.
Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.
Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.
About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.
Benefits & Wellbeing
Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.
The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Csod
description:
About NIIT
At NIIT, we're transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That's why the world's best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

Title: CSOD Implementation consultant
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone On Demand (CSOD)
Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments
Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner Responsibilities:
Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
Actively and effectively partner with L& D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
Identify and communicate system and process issues to L& D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
AHelbor Empreendimentos S. A.é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado daB3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a)Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESGpara integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesApoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.Requisitos e qualificaçõesFormação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.Informações adicionais

title: Senior collections policy analyst
description:

Analyze the behavior of customers with short-, medium-, and long-term delinquencies to identify opportunities for improvement;
Create and refine data-driven collections policies to reduce risk and increase recovery;
Use SQL and Python to extract insights and generate strategic reports;
Explain to the business and sales teams why analytical strategies work and demonstrate the value of the solutions;
Work closely with the Data Science and Operations teams.

Experience: Previous experience with data analysis focused on collections or credit risk;
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Big Query, and Python;
Practical Approach: Ability to translate numbers into actions that solve customer problems;
Communication: Ability to explain complex results in a simple way to different teams;
Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.

Knowledge of discount policies, portfolio write-offs, and pricing

Analisar o comportamento dos clientes com incumprimentos a curto, médio e longo prazo para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;

Experiência: Experiência anterior em análise de dados focada em cobranças ou risco de crédito;

Inglês.

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:O Grupo Capital:Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.Responsabilidades:Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.Pré-requisitos:Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
Proatividade orientada a resultados;
Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.Diferencial:Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.Você terá:Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
Programa departnershipestruturado;
Treinamentos exclusivos;
Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.Modo de contratação:Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Python/cloud platform developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform DeveloperImportant Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryWe seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.Responsibilities and DutiesDevelop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5 G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.Essential SkillsSolid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
How to work on the command line and with files;
How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
How to create and run simple scripts;
Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Docker;
Experience with Helm.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Postgre SQL as a developer;
Experience with Rabbit MQ as a developer.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;

title: Gerente de operações financeiras (financial operations manager)
description:

Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.

Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills :
Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management.
JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language.
REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required.
Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.

Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

description:

Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.Highly Desirable SkillsHands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora My SQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
