title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills :
Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management.
JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language.
REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required.
Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.

Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

title: Especialista de operações (operations specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:
Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus
Job type: Full TimeResponsabilidades:
Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.
Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
Fluência em Português e Inglês;proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.
O que oferecemos:
Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.
Qualificações Preferenciais:
Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.
Tipo de vaga:Tempo Integral
Termos Técnicos:Mantive termos como Stablecoin, VASP, OTC, SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
Adaptação Cultural:O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...

title: Gerente de operações financeiras (financial operations manager)
description:
Responsibilities:
Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.Requirements:
3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus
Job type: Full Time﻿Responsabilidades:
Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.
Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards.
Requisitos:
Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance).
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
Fluência em Português e Inglês;proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.
O que oferecemos:
Salário e benefícios competitivos.
Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Encarregado de operações logística
description:
Atibaia – SP
Sobre a empresa
A Balmer é uma indústria brasileira com mais de 40 anos de atuação, reconhecida como uma das maiores fabricantes de equipamentos de soldagem e corte da América do Sul. Com tecnologia própria e produção nacional, a empresa se destaca pela qualidade, robustez e inovação de seus produtos.
Presente em todo o Brasil e América do Sul, conta com ampla rede de assistência técnica e estrutura sólida voltada à eficiência operacional.
Sobre a posição
Atuação na organização e execução das operações do CD, garantindo fluxo de pedidos, controle de estoque e integração com comercial e logística.
Principais responsabilidades
Acompanhar e garantir o fluxo dos pedidos desde a entrada no sistema até a expedição, assegurando que não haja pedidos parados ou atrasos na operação:
Realizar a separação e conferência de pedidos, apoiando diretamente a operação do almoxarifado;
Controlar e monitorar os níveis de estoque, apoiando inventários e prevenindo rupturas ou divergências;
Conferir notas fiscais de entrada e saída de mercadorias, assegurando a conformidade com os pedidos e evitando inconsistências;
Realizar cotações e interface com transportadoras, definindo a melhor alternativa de frete para cada envio;
Acompanhar a expedição e entrega dos pedidos, garantindo prazos e qualidade no atendimento ao cliente;
Atuar como ponto de contato entre a operação do CD e a equipe comercial;
Apoiar a organização e manutenção do galpão, acompanhando prestadores de serviço terceirizados (limpeza, manutenção, entre outros);
Apoiar a gestão do auxiliar de almoxarifado e contribuir para a estruturação da operação conforme crescimento da equipe. Requisitos
· Experiência em operações de almoxarifado, logística ou expedição;
· Vivência com controle de pedidos, estoque e interface com transportadoras;
· Conhecimento em pacote Office;
· Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas; e
· Desejável habilitação para operação de empilhadeira.
Diferencial da posição
Essa posição possui potencial de crescimento para atuação em liderança conforme a expansão da operação do Centro de Distribuição.

title: Accounting manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting ManagerLocation:Fully Remote working for US-Based ClientsAbout Us
We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. Weekly
• Review customer invoicing
• Review vendor bills and submit payments
• Approve and submit payroll

• Review cash flow forecasts
• Resolve collections issues
• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller
Monthly
• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook
• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook
• Perform source document filing spot checks
• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and
payment
• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff
Accountant
• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages
• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff
Accountant
• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month
• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,
graphs, and footnotes
• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their
technical accounting skills
• Review process and procedural documents
Quarterly
• Complete 941 reconciliations
• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval
Annually
• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually
• Review the chart of accounts
• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income
statement to retained earnings
• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency
• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review
New Client Implementation
• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents
• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on
• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End
Workbook, and Financial Package
• Delegate updates to Staff AccountantRequirements
4+ years of accounting experience
Experience working with U. S.-based clients and exposure to U. S. GAAP

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
Fluent English (written and spoken)
Accounting or Finance degree
Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm ESTCompensation & Benefits
USD 3,000–3,500 per month, based on experience
Fully remoterole with some flexibility included
Paid training in U. S. GAAP and internal processes
Access to TGG University and learning resources
Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)Notes:
This position is to join us as Independent Contractor
Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)
Working Equipment to start is required
PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leaveAbout TGG Accounting

Loyalty
Integrity
Strong Work Ethic
Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
Team Player / Caring / Selfless
Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
Freedom & Accountability

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Ugc content creator (freelance)
description:
About the CompanyWe are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.Role Overview
Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for Tik Tok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.
Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.
Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.
Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.Candidate Profile
Strong interest in Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.
Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).
Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.
Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.
Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.
Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.
English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.Compensation
Per-Video Payment Model:

description:

Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.

Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.

Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretionRequired Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretionAdditional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plusAbout Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Senior api engineer (nodejs, ts, sdui)
description:
About the Company:Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.
Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.Role summary:
Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.Key responsibilities:
Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience:
7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
Hands-on development inType Scriptfor backend services.
Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as Postgre SQL, My SQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS/Elasti Cache or equivalents).
Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Open Telemetry, etc.).
Good spoken EnglishNice to have:
Terraform or other Ia C for managing AWS resources.
Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals:
Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Health/Sport budget
Remote work
Flexible PTO
Global offices
Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Cientista de dados (ia)
description:
Estamos em busca de umCientista de Dadoscom atuação na implementação de soluções comIA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.Formação:
Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.Habilidades Técnicas:
Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
Conhecimento em SQL/No SQL;
Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises eResponsabilidades e atribuições:
Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.Por que escolher a Geosistemas?Saúde e Bem-Estar:

Auxílio Home Office no cartão Caju.

Day Off no seu aniversário + presente especial (voucher Caju).Desenvolvimento e Crescimento:

2 horas semanais dedicadas a estudos durante o expediente.
Acesso às plataformas Alura, Imagine e Feedz para aprendizado contínuo.
Programas de Desenvolvimento focados em habilidades técnicas, comportamentais e de negócios.
Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) com capacitações sob medida.
Feedbacks regulares para apoiar sua evolução.Reconhecimento e Oportunidades:
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) anual, vinculada ao desempenho.
Movimentação Interna para explorar novas posições e crescer.
Plano de Sucessão com foco no desenvolvimento de líderes e talentos juniores.Trabalhe conosco e faça parte de um time que investe no seu crescimento e bem-estar!

title: Senior api engineer (nodejs, ts, sdui)
description:
About the Company:
Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.
Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.Role summary:
Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.Key responsibilities:
Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience:
7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
Hands-on development inType Scriptfor backend services.
Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as Postgre SQL, My SQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS/Elasti Cache or equivalents).
Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Open Telemetry, etc.).
Good spoken EnglishNice to have:
Terraform or other Ia C for managing AWS resources.
Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals:
Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Health/Sport budget
Remote work
Flexible PTO
Global offices
Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior content manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement

title: Cientista de dados (ia)
description:
Estamos em busca de umCientista de Dadoscom atuação na implementação de soluções comIA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.Formação:
Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.Habilidades Técnicas:
Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
Conhecimento em SQL/No SQL;
Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises eResponsabilidades e atribuições:
Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;

description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.
With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.
Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.What are we looking for?
5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
3+ years of professional experience with Node JS;
2 + years of professional experience with Next JS;
Fluency in English (mandatory);
Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).What do we have to offer you?
Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.What makes us different?
Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
We promote closeness and an informal environment;
Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.Your next adventure starts here!
If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!
The future is waiting for you — and so are we!
